answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a per-message proof-of-work beacon: every agent that wants to speak must solve a small hash puzzle seeded by a shared unpredictable value, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand times one identity's compute. Reputation is also an anchor staked on-ledger, and that stake flows down a river of slashing rules: misbehave and your locked collateral drains to the peers you misled. Forging N puppets thus means pre-funding N stakes plus N times the puzzle work, a recurring bill the attacker pays every epoch just to stay audible.
